english.title: Use / cause / permit vehicle to be used in dangerous condition at Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Southampton Airport where the (D)_[parts and accessories of the vehicle were not in such condition, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DEFECTIVE CONDITION..),]_
(E)_[number of passengers carried by the vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NUMBER OF PASSENGERS CARRIED..),was not such]_
(F)_[manner in which passengers were carried, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MANNER OF CARRIAGE..),was not such]_
(G)_[weight, distribution, packing and adjustment of the load of the vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DANGER IN THE LOAD..),was not such]_

that no danger was caused or was likely to be caused to any person in or on the vehicle or on the Airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(8)(a) and 2(3) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: The act in this Byelaw is prohibited on any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
